zh.title: 数字员工迟迟没交报告，主管该找谁？
zh.summary: 同一张对账工单在 CodeFlowMu 本地跑了九次。任务没送达、等待审批、已有结果但没交报告，都可能得到同一个队列结果。

en.title: The agent still hasn’t filed its report. Who should the manager ask?
en.summary: Nine local runs in CodeFlowMu show how an undelivered task, a pending approval, and a saved result can all produce the same report queue response.
